column1: # Session-export segments for pi-memory-export. The company layer's qmd/segments.tsv is read first.
# skip: never exported. path: cwd equals the glob or sits under it. remote: substring of the
# origin URL of the cwd's git repo. mixed: cwd exactly; the first matching strong rule wins, then the
# segment with the highest signal score, else this one. strong/signal match user turns, the worker
# assignment, the session name and tool-call lines. Single sessions are pinned in session-overrides.tsv.
